_comment: Layout and state geometry for checkbox. Colours come from the Figma mirror (colors/checkbox); these do not. RE-VERIFIED against Figma component set `checkbox` (14291:131502) on 2026-08-19 by reading all 14 variants — the first two builds were both wrong, see _corrections.

_figma_truth_table._note: All 14 variants read on 2026-08-19. Every variant is 24x24, radius 4, padding 2. `Primary Color=No` is green, `Yes` is red. The glyph appears in exactly two states.
_figma_truth_table.Empty: fill checkbox-bg-white · border checkbox-border 1px inside · no glyph
_figma_truth_table.Selected: fill checkbox-bg-green | checkbox-bg-red · no border · glyph outline-check 20 in checkbox-fg-white
_figma_truth_table.All Seleted: fill checkbox-bg-green | checkbox-bg-red · no border · glyph filled-minus 20 in checkbox-fg-white
_figma_truth_table.Disable: fill checkbox-bg-disable (#F5F5F5) · border checkbox-border 1px · no glyph
_figma_truth_table.Focus: fill #FFFFFF · border 1.5px tone · drop shadow blur 5 spread 3 at 35% tone · no glyph

_source.size: The Figma frame is 24x24 with 2px padding on every variant.
_source.radius: 4, which is exactly semantic.radius.sm. Figma states it as a literal on the frame.
_source.border-width-emphasis: 1.5px on Hover, Focus and Error. No semantic border-width role carries 1.5 — hairline is 1 and thin is 2 — so the literal stands until one exists.
_source.glyph-size: 20px `icons-size` instance, present only on Selected and All Seleted.
_source.focus-ring-*: Figma uses a DROP_SHADOW with blur 5, spread 3 and the tone at 35% alpha — not the 40% ring the rest of the library uses. Kept verbatim because Figma is the value authority.
_source.height: The row height the Frontend gives a checkbox with a label (h-8). Not from Figma, which ships the control alone.

_corrections._why_twice: This component was rebuilt twice from wrong readings. Recorded in full because the failure mode — reading a hidden node and believing it — is not specific to checkbox.
_corrections.build-1: Drew the box in CSS and invented a radius, border width and focus ring. Wrong values, right idea.
_corrections.build-2: Concluded 'Figma draws the whole control as an icon' and removed the box entirely. That was read off `Outline/Old/Check` — a HIDDEN, ORPHANED legacy instance sitting inside every unchecked variant. The result rendered a tick when the box was empty and had no box at all.
_corrections.build-3: Read all 14 variants and their frame properties. The frame draws the box (fill, stroke, radius 4); the icon is only the glyph, and only on two states.
_corrections.icon-size-rest: REMOVED. There is no glyph at rest — 18px was the size of the hidden legacy node.
_corrections.unchecked-glyph: Was `outline-check` rendered at rest, so an unticked box showed a tick. Figma shows nothing.

_figma_gaps.unbound-strokes: The Hover, Focus and Error strokes are raw hexes with no bound variable. Hover and Focus match status.success.default (#22C55E) and primary.default (#E32321) exactly, so they are bound here; Figma should bind them too.
_figma_gaps.error-uses-the-old-red: DECIDED 2026-08-19 — follow Figma. The Error stroke is #EF4444, Tailwind's red.500, which this design system overrode to #E32321 everywhere else. It matches no token, so it is held as a literal in `border-error` rather than silently swapped for the brand red. Figma is the value authority and the team chose to keep it; if the intent later changes, the fix is one value in this file.
_figma_gaps.no-checked-hover: Figma draws no Hover, Focus or Error variant for a checked box. This component keeps the checked fill and layers the emphasis border, which is an extrapolation, not a reading.

_verified_from.scope: all 14 variants, every frame property and nested glyph
_verified_from.result: Rebuilt from the full truth table; see `_figma_truth_table` and `_corrections`. Measured in the browser afterwards: 7 of 7 state/colour combinations match, box 24x24, radius 4, focus ring #22C55E at 35% with blur 5 and spread 3.

_figma_icons._comment: The icons Figma instantiates for this component, read 2026-08-20 by walking the instance tree and keeping every main component whose parent set is `icons`. check-figma-icons.py holds the files in `sources` to exactly this set — an extra icon fails as loudly as a missing one, because an extra is one nobody compared. Files not listed in `sources` carry payload a caller passes, not a choice the design makes.

icons.filled-minus: State=All Seleted (Figma's spelling) — the indeterminate box
icons.outline-check: State=Selected, both Primary Color=Yes and No
